An '''electrum helmet''' is the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] [[Armor#Helmet|helmet]], made by smithing a [[Diamond Helmet|diamond helmet]] with [[Electrum Alloy|electrum alloy]]. It gives 3 armor and 3 toughness and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/electrum_helmet.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/electrum/helmet</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 3 armor, 3 armor toughness.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Warding|{{G|Electrum}} +1]]

Wearing the full set adds the electrum [[Set bonus|set bonus]].

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Electrum equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

Because electrum equipment uses the same item IDs as adamant, the recipe returns an adamant alloy, not electrum.

=== Trading ===
A [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] of level 2 (Apprentice) buys it for one [[Electrum Alloy|electrum alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/electrum_helmet.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Armor durability and protection were made consistent across tiers (leather < copper < gold, sturdy leather < iron, shakudo, hepatizon, steel < diamond, electrum < adamant). Added translation support for all armor and tools. Fixed electrum tools and weapons, whose Warding did not work.}}
{{History line|1.03|Electrum alloy now needs a [[Divine Fragment|divine fragment]], like adamant, and has an enchantment glint.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats. Buffed electrum, and made the set bonus clearer.}}
{{History line|1.12|Fixed severe multiplayer lag caused by electrum armor.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys. Electrum became the only source of Fortune III, and it can only be repaired with blocks of diamond. The set bonus was nerfed from 4 to 2 hearts.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Electrum equipment no longer burns in fire or lava, and electrum armor counts as armor that piglins accept.}}
}}
